designationHistory.indexText: Yukon Delta National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1980 to protect the wildlife and diverse habitats nestled on the delta between the mighty Yukon and Kuskokwim rivers of Alaska.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
